displayName: OCI-PCI-008: PCI-DSS — Excessive Privileges in CDE
description:
Detects users with excessive privileges in cardholder data environment violating least privilege

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_pci_008", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%pci%' AND "value" > 0
